name: hotel-agent
description: Hotel booking platform: Express + MongoDB API and Next.js admin dashboard

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix admin install && node scripts/init-env.mjs
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,admin -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix admin start"
